qa_pairs.question: What screw size and torque specification applies to A4S 270R/A4S 310R/A5S 310Z/A5S 300J/A5S 440Z/A5S 560Z transmissions for torque converter to flywheel?
What is the difference in torque specifications between the specific transmission types and all other types when using M10 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: 4 Nm difference - specific transmission types use 45 Nm while all others use 49 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What component is being torqued according to the specifications shown in this table?
How many different torque specifications are listed for the torque converter to flywheel connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different specifications: 26 Nm for M8 screws, 45 Nm for specific transmissions with M10 screws, and 49 Nm for all other transmissions with M10 screws
